name: SDF NSVF Models
text:
# SDF NSVF Models


## Overview
[SDF](#1466-signed-distance-fields-sdf.md) [NSVF](#7144-neural-sparse-voxel-fields-nsvf.md) models are [neural volume rendering](#1576-neural-volume-rendering.md) architectures that represent geometry using a signed distance field (SDF) radiance field, registered as 'sdf_nsvf' and 'sdf_nsvf_sfx' [S1, unofficial]. They differ from sibling [Disco NSVF models](#11063-disco-nsvf-models.md) by explicitly modeling the implicit surface geometry via the SDF rather than relying solely on disentangled density fields, enabling precise [surface extraction](#29-surface-extraction.md) [S1, unofficial].

## Shared principles
The family shares the core mechanism of a neural field that maps 3D coordinates to geometric and radiance properties. Specifically, the SDF variant utilizes an `sdf_radiance_field` structure [S1, unofficial]. This implies the network outputs a signed distance value for spatial queries, which defines the surface isosurface (typically at zero), alongside color information. The implementation relies on the `nerf2nope_architecture` for the underlying MLP structure [S1, unofficial].

## Subtopics

### sdf_nsvf
The standard SDF NSVF model. It is configured with `feature_layers=6`, `feature_field_skip_connect=3`, and `no_layernorm_mlp=True`. It uses the `nerf2nope_architecture`. Choose this when standard [SDF-based volume rendering](#9964-sdf-based-volume-rendering.md) with specific MLP depth and skip-connection patterns is required. See [sdf_nsvf](11064-sdf-nsvf.md).

### sdf_nsvf_sfx
A variant that uses the `surface_volume_rendering` raymarcher. This suggests a rendering approach that integrates along rays but may leverage the SDF for [surface-aware sampling](#5532-local-sampling.md) or shading. Choose this when surface-aware volume rendering is preferred over standard alpha-compositing. See [sdf_nsvf_sfx](11065-sdf-nsvf-sfx.md).

## Background
The SDF NSVF models originate from the NSVF (Neural Scene Volume Fields) project by Facebook Research [S1, unofficial]. The codebase provides these models as registered implementations for [neural scene representation](#12421-implicit-methods-sdf-based.md). The specific configuration details (layer counts, skip connections) are defined in the model registration logic [S1, unofficial].
